system.name: BMAD-Speckit-SDD-Flow
system.description: Local AI-TDD governance and requirement-contract control plane for BMAD and Spec-Kit host sessions, CLI install surfaces, runtime gates, evidence records, scoring, and npm release packaging.

sources.summary: Root package defines bmad-speckit-sdd-flow v2.0.3, npm bin wrappers, workspace packages, install/init scripts, main-agent gates, build scripts, CI-equivalent test scripts, bundle dependencies, and public npm packaging.

Internal bmad-speckit workspace defines bin/bmad-speckit.js, bin/bmad-speckit-init.js, dist/src files, package-local main-agent dist build, package tests, Node >=18, and bundled internal dependencies.

Primary CLI entry registers init, check, version, upgrade, uninstall, add-agent, goal-contract, large-doc, scoring, dashboard, runtime-mcp, bmads, bmad-help, main-agent, and dist/main-agent gate commands.

Main-agent runtime parses actions, dispatches supported package runtime actions, routes inspect, confirm-scope, dispatch-plan, run-loop, release-gate, quality-gate, delivery-truth-gate, and package migrated actions.
Runtime inspect reads _bmad-output/runtime/requirement-records/index.json and requirement-record.json files and exposes active requirement state and orchestration state.
BMADS runtime console resolves active RequirementRecords, six mental model status, blockers, safety priority, next safe action, and goal route recommendations.

Native goal support resolves Codex and Claude Code CLI hosts, validates goal execution document hashes and audit receipts, writes main-session-required receipts, and blocks child execution of long-running native goals.

Install and init flow creates skeletons, validates selected AI targets, syncs commands/rules/agents/skills/protocols/hooks for Cursor, Claude, and Codex, deploys .specify, and writes install manifests.
BMADS runtime config defines canonical command aliases, five workflow layers, stages, recommended workflows, host dispatch targets, evidence paths, and closeout/release gates.

Main-agent governance contract defines strategy source of truth, runtime index source, forbidden duplicated strategy sources, required signals, stage requirements, mapping rules, and block/warn gate policy.

AI-TDD six-model manifest defines Requirement Confirmation, Architecture Confirmation, Implementation Readiness, Execution Closure, Audit Review, and Delivery Confirmation with artifacts and terminal events.

@bmad-speckit/runtime-context writes and reads _bmad-output/runtime/context/project.json, scoped run/story/epic contexts, runtime registry, active scope, implementation entry index, and sprint-status derived context.

@bmad-speckit/runtime-emit bundles emit-runtime-policy, resolve-for-session, render-audit-block, consumer MCP, runtime audit, and auditor host CJS artifacts for hook and MCP consumer runtime without ts-node.
@bmad-speckit/scoring provides audit parsing, score calculation, writer/query/coach/dashboard/runtime projection, SFT analytics, CLI score command, and dashboard output under _bmad-output.
@bmad-speckit/ralph-method exports tracking, schema, TDD trace verification, compliance verification, and speckit implement helpers used for Ralph/Cursor execution mode.
GitHub workflows build packages, lint, run governance fixtures, vitest, package tests, main-agent gates, chaos tests, npm dry-run/pack/publish, GitHub release upload, and deferred-gap audit.

Project documentation describes BMAD-Speckit as an AI-TDD control plane using host entries such as $bmads, /bmads, bmad-speckit, requirement contracts, evidence chains, and BMAD plus Spec-Kit workflows.
@bmad-speckit/schema publishes shared JSON schemas for run score records, canonical SFT samples, and dataset bundle manifests.

assumptions.text: Specific LLM provider endpoints are UNKNOWN in this repository; the overview models AI Host / LLM Provider Execution as a host-managed external dependency because the product operates through Codex, Claude Code CLI, and Cursor host sessions.
The user requested one System Architecture Overview only; context, container, component, deployment, and security detail views are intentionally omitted for this generation.

No cloud VPC, CDN, WAF, or server deployment is proven by source files; TAM network/trust boundaries in this diagram are logical filesystem, host-session, package-runtime, and external-service boundaries.
Publication SVG/PNG rendering depends on local diagrams.net or drawio CLI availability; the editable drawio file remains the primary artifact.
